title: Support TrailStat.si
intro: TrailStat.si is free, with no advertising and no tracking. If you find it useful, you can help pay for the server with a donation.
off: Donations are not open at the moment.

qr.title: Pay with your banking app
qr.alt: UPN QR code for a donation of {{amount}}
qr.altOwnAmount: UPN QR code for a donation, without an amount
qr.howTo: Scan the code in your bank's mobile app, with the option to pay a UPN QR. The details are filled in for you; you can still change the amount before you pay.

direct: The money goes straight to the bank account above. TrailStat.si never handles it, and records nothing about donations.
